items.title: RONALDO x UNITED - MYTH BUSTED
items.summary:
RONALDO x UNITED - MYTH BUSTED

"If he stayed he'd be United GOAT" [@TheAthleticFC]

MATH:
United sold CR7 2009 for €94M after paying €19M in 2003 = €75M profit + 6yrs of AIG shirt sales boom
If he stayed 2009-13 instead of Real: United wage bill +€15M/yr, would have blocked Rooney/Van Persie peak
Real turned that €94M into 450 goals + 4 UCLs + €1B commercial = 10x ROI
United got 2nd spell free: €15M fee + £400k/wk = £26M/yr for 27 goals = £1M per goal, worst ROI ever

First spell made him, second spell killed the myth.
